clips.title: The story
paras: Winna Hazzard is an eccentric Forsaken researcher stationed at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood. Accompanied by a feline companion and known for bouts of maniacal laughter, she studies the blighted ecosystem and conducts unsettling experiments with the zone's corrupted fauna.

Winna Hazzard represents the Forsaken interest in Felwood's unnatural decay. Stationed in the Horde enclave of Bloodvenom Post, she spends her time observing the local wildlife and formulating experiments utilizing tainted waters and venomous samples. Her jovial, manic demeanor often masks callous motives, evident when she uses tainted liquids drawn from the land to corrupt the small kitten that stays by her side.
